text_html:
### Touchscreen Mapping (Slots 1 to 4)
Use these to map physical USB touchscreens to specific displays or fix inverted input axes.
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.vendor: USB Vendor ID (hex, e.g., 27c6).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.product: USB Product ID (hex, e.g., 0118).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.display: Target display ID (e.g., local:0, local:1, or none to unmap).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.orientation: Hardware rotation of the digitizer (0, 1, 2, 3).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.flip_x: Invert X-axis (1 or true).
- persist.ax86.touch.<SLOT>.flip_y: Invert Y-axis (1 or true).
- Apply Changes: setprop sys.ax86.touch.update 1
